pieces.name: Hermann Goering
pieces.notes: Name prints bottom-to-top (rot 90 clockwise makes it upright). One large rounded slot with a red/white Luftwaffe flag badge, vertical stripes white/black/white at its edge as printed; hero portrait and two small unit pictures.
